en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Mind-produced (Cittasamuṭṭhānaduka)

Dependent on a non-demonstrable, non-reactive state originated by consciousness, there arises a non-demonstrable, non-reactive state not originated by consciousness by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root, three under object … pe … six under non-disappearance.
